notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
vnstat is a network traffic monitor that logs bandwidth usage per interface over time (daily/monthly/total). Used during vulnerability assessments and pentests to monitor scan impact, verify scan traffic reached the target, or detect unexpected bandwidth anomalies.

=== CHAINING ===
Before scan: vnstat -i eth0 → run vulnerability scan → vnstat -i eth0 -d → compare delta to understand scan traffic volume. Useful for estimating scan footprint and documenting assessment activity.

=== CONTEXT ===
Vulnerability scanners generate significant traffic (Nessus can send thousands of packets per host per minute). vnstat helps quantify this and identify if scan traffic is reaching the target interface.
